intro: Controlled reference screens within Office Management.
referenceBanner: REFERENCE ONLY — Fictional TaxPay v11 officer screenshots. Not live NBR/ACS/Treasury data. Officer permissions, posting, approvals, and real tax credits are disabled.
reviewOnly: No posting or approval is possible from this reference view.
twoStatuses: Government financial receipt and NBR taxpayer credit are separate statuses. A challan or receipt alone does not prove eligible tax credit.
name: Name
noReveal: Sensitive identifiers remain masked. Revealing an NID requires verified server authorization and a durable audit record.
noLedgerAssertion: The illustration does not constitute an authoritative taxpayer ledger, refund balance, or entitlement.
notConnected: No verified authoritative data connection is available for this screen.
makerChain: Production corrections require three distinct authorized officers: Maker → Reviewer → Approver. The current preview cannot change a payment or credit.
noIncidentRows: No incident source records were verified in the supplied prototype screenshots.
allegations: Reports are allegations, not proven findings. Containment and disclosure require independent role checks, evidence and audit.
noPosting: Offline events must preserve the original source/order, component, year, maker, separate approver and duplicate prevention. Nothing is posted from this screen.
analyticsDisclaimer: FICTIONAL DESIGN METRICS — These values are from the v11 screenshots, not connected to payment monitoring, bank services or production telemetry.

noUpload: Description only. File attachment and immutable evidence storage are not yet integrated.
amountError: Amount must be a positive number
cannotSave: Validated locally for review; NOT submitted or saved to the authority.
fictionalChannel: Illustrative design benchmark; no actual transaction or service monitoring.
monitoringNotice: Runtime health checks are not connected. Do not infer availability from this demonstration.
incidentNoIdentityOracle: No TIN/NID/mobile match is confirmed by this local preview. A reporter need not know the affected TIN. Identity verification must precede account-specific action.
